original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Four further paired input/output extractions on PR2917's final words, all at hyperplane normal 45 (helpers 249, 267, 251, 265 restored at E_45, ten declared inherited-frame edits, 86 private buffers), a literal T74 allocation of the changed inventory, and complete fresh-native admission and modern outer release against the PR2930 headline.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed helper inventory beats current packing. PR2930 showed that the fill layer of PR2917's words is exhausted (its allocation attains their exact packing cap), so further gains must change the words. A census of single further extractions on PR2917's final word finds none at break-even; the joint composition of four extractions sharing one hyperplane lowers the paid local profile enough to raise the packing cap above PR2930's. As in PR2917, the paired basis change alters the scalar word and endpoint contract; finite exact identities and a fully charged literal allocation are required.
bottleneck_link: Four helpers change width 9 to 8 and four private buffers are added; the local profile changes by 18H1 - 8H2 + 6H3 - 6H4 per call. The fixed-capacity cap of the changed inventory rises from PR2930's 0.0017224999064 to 0.0017228172707; the literal allocation realizes all but 9.5e-10 of it, charging every unused owner remainder.
stop_rule: Freeze the four-step composition after exact local checks; publish a higher conditional kappa only if both native providers, literal owner geometry, physical stock, prefix and complete outer admission pass strictly above the PR2930 headline.
evidence: Search (construction/EXTRACTION-STEPS.json): the exact cost identity total(U,P) = Delta_end(U u P) + c1|U - P| reproduces the composition (-25,311,496 + 8 c1 = -8,378,128); every complete rank-4 composition at normal 45 touches the same 12 registers whose only helpers are the four pivots (three other orders end at exactly -8,378,128); no other normal has a positive margin before or after. Checks: run_registered.py (stdlib): package pins; verify.py (producer reconstruction, four structure certificates per provider, PR2833 auditor forward/dual on both words, frame accounting, 40 semantic controls, overlay spec round trip); check_allocation.py (owner engine, five controls, physical 66,808, exact moment vs PR2930); check_cap.py (Fractions-only cap certificate of the changed inventory, recorded literal gap); stored receipts binding. reproduce.py: exact Git exports of PR2908/PR2917/PR2930 (and through them PR2894/PR2833), fresh retained bootstrap, PR2917 derived source plus the normal45-paired-extractions stage, 86-buffer adapters, fresh native chains for both providers and complete admission: PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE and PASS_RELEASE at the claimed kappa.
author: Marius-Paul Dumitrean
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance (Anthropic Claude via Claude Code) for search, implementation, exact computation and checks; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can edits outside the paired-extraction lever lower the 88,556-unit overhead of the 12-register universe at normal 45, or make other normals profitable?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Within the present cost model (output gates at the end of restore, the fixed gate order with exactly re-solved frames, zero-entry pivots) the four-step composition is the optimum of the lever: its certified cost depends only on the touched set and the pivots, every complete rank-4 composition at normal 45 touches the same 12 registers, and no other normal has a positive margin before or after it.
open_questions.first_step: Price gate re-timings that let registers 62, 63, 2 and 94 reach E_45 more cheaply, output gates placed before the end of restore, and entering-helper (start_extra) pivots with the certified frame solver, then re-run the per-normal census with the cost identity.
open_questions.blocked_by: These edits change the gate order or the entrance contract and need their own exact local, owner and complete admission chain.

open_questions.question: Can the changed inventory be packed closer to its cap?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Its fractional optimum is fractional at T74 ([9^5] 396/5 per replica); the literal fill is 9.5e-10 below the cap.
open_questions.first_step: Try other chronologies (e.g. a T148 doubling of the T74 flow) or PR2863-style lockstep copies with vacancy relays, and price with root.py.
open_questions.blocked_by: Integrality of the basic solution at T74.

open_questions.question: Do other frontier words admit profitable joint compositions?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The cost identity total(U,P) = Delta_end(U u P) + c1 |U \ P| prices a whole composition with one certified solver call per (normal, support universe), so the joint test is cheap on any word.
open_questions.first_step: For each candidate word, compute the admissible pairing rank and support universe per normal, price the universes with the identity, and synthesize gates only where the shared overhead fits under k x 25,371.
